chapter.heading: Psalm 3
Save Me, O My God
A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
chapter.v: “There is no salvation for him in God.” Selah
I woke again, for the Lord sustained me.
set themselves against me all around.
break the teeth of the wicked.
your blessing be on your people! Selah

footnotes.footnote: 3:2 The meaning of the Hebrew word *Selah*, used frequently in the Psalms, is uncertain. It may be a musical or liturgical direction
